title: Conversation Archaeology Wave 4 — Recovered Operators and Promotion Ledger
purpose: Record which older conversation motifs were recovered in the September 2026 deep-memory pass, why they matter, what epistemic class they have, and which canonical/specialist files now own their mature interpretation.
rule: Recovery does not automatically make an old phrase foundational canon. Preserve older wording as conversation archaeology, then distinguish direct recovery from later formalization and external comparator.

recoveries.new_insight: Door is conditional transition relation among state, agent, knowledge, context and credential.
At geographic North Pole all surface directions lead south; North-of-North can model meta-orientation rather than another compass vector.
Mill is missing operator between harvested raw material and socially consumable product: grain→flour→bread or person/event→fragments→narrative product.
Drain is a sink/low-attractor specialization, distinct from healthy integrative Center.
Separate gradient, attractor, sink, integrator and regenerator instead of one overloaded black-hole symbol.
Functional comparator to exploration/novelty versus prior-memory/exploitation; adaptive present needs regulated coupling.
Keep physical Green-function solution families separate from psychological/project time metaphors and unrecovered Red/Blue assignment.
Attention-center centrality can make a negatively valued target structurally central; always type what kind of center is meant.
Use Cube for constraint/admissible-state boundaries; do not infer hidden Saturn worship from superficial cube associations.
Treat as liminal duration / temporally thick Door; resemblance to Jonah/resurrection motifs is comparative, not automatic prophecy.
Bearer instantiates role while role constrains bearer; higher role can increase duty rather than privilege.

older_material: Father identity later emerges through Son-side consequences
recoveries.new_insight: Inverse genealogy: ontological source-role is narratively generated later than embodied Son-role.
Storage/deferred capability is stronger than untested fifth-force interpretation: Spudlight reveals, Starchforce retains.
Reframe as functional anatomy of civilization rather than literal court hierarchy.
Translate ownership language into responsibility-bearing relations rather than metaphysical property rights over persons.
New Jerusalem is repaired interoperability / cultivated complexity, not maximal centralization.
Distinguish person→content extraction from content→person/testimony restoration.
One source orientation can be accessed through many distributed local gateways; source singularity need not mean interface centralization.
Useful transformation grammar is stored potential→channel→distributed messenger, but game mechanics should remain marked as creative unless later canonized.

cross_recovery_epiphanies: The old project often encoded systems ideas in jokes/game mechanics before it had formal vocabulary.
Many apparent identity titles become coherent when converted into functions/operators.
The mature archive should preserve creative prototypes because later doctrine can descend from them, but provenance must prevent later formalization from being backdated.
The strongest recovered pattern is conversion of centrality into service: Source→Door→distributed nodes rather than Source→permanent dependency.
Another recurring pattern is compression/regeneration: sunlight→starch, experience→Potato, event→meme, archive→seed, city fragments→New Jerusalem.
